observed: Result: Passed on staging under Standing Rule 131: the current PRD (v64) says a work order given its lead after it was created goes to the bottom of that technician's work, and the build does exactly that.

Set-up: four Approved work orders made in this order: S2-37303 (Zeta), S2-37304 (Alpha), S2-37305 (Mid), S2-37306 (Mid); their lead (ZZAUTOTEST C96929 Kit 85057) was then given in this order: S2-37303, S2-37305, S2-37306, S2-37304. Viewed as a new user who never saved a sort (ZZAUTOTEST C96929 Sort Viewer 85057, opened with switch-user).
List (default sort, customer name A to Z): S2-37304 (Alpha), S2-37306 (Mid), S2-37305 (Mid), S2-37303 (Zeta).
Tech View, the technician's group: S2-37303, S2-37305, S2-37306, S2-37304 - the order the leads were given. Board View, the technician's column: the same order as Tech View.
PRD Confluence 845185030, version 64 (16 Oct 2026), S2-R6: "A work order that gets a new lead after it was created goes to the bottom of that technician’s work instead (S9-R14)."

Same PRD, S9-R14: "A work order that gets a new lead from the Reassign lead technician dialog or from its detail page goes to the bottom of the new technician’s work, for everyone at the location, in both views."

When it changed: PRD change log, version 53, 15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward (product owner): "S9-R14 confirmed as written: a lead given after creation puts the work order at the bottom of that technician’s work (SV-11312 works as specified)."
Ticket SV-11101 was closed by the developer (Slavcho Mitrov, 15 Oct) as working per S9-R14. The developer's comment alone is not the reason for this pass; the PRD, written by the product owner, is.
The case's own expected results (written to PRD version 54) still expect Tech View and Board View to follow List's order; the QA lead will be asked to update the case.

Result: Passed on staging under Standing Rule 131: the current PRD only asks for a success message that fades by itself, and the product owner has ruled the app's standard success message is the right look.

Seen today: S2-37307 dragged from Unassigned into ZZAUTOTEST DC21's column; "Lead technician updated" appeared at the bottom right as the app's standard green success message with a white tick and "Close", and it went away by itself after about 7.3 seconds without the mouse over it.

Product owner's comment on SV-11396 (Chris Ward, 16 Oct 2026 09:23), word for word: "closing this one. The "Lead technician updated" message uses the app's standard success toast, the same as every success message in ShopView. Restyling only these two would make them unlike the rest of the app, so they stay on the app standard. Not a defect for this feature."

PRD Confluence 845185030, version 64 (16 Oct 2026), section 9 User Feedback Summary: Lead technician changed by drag or dialog (S4-R5) - "Lead technician updated" - "Success toast, auto-fades". The version that added this row is not shown in the PRD change log; it is in the live version 64 of 16 Oct 2026.
Same PRD, S4-R16: "Success toasts dismiss automatically."
The case's own expected results follow the design picture (a white box with an X); the QA lead will be asked to update the case.
